name: Citation Formatter
description: Formats source citations consistently (MLA, APA, or Chicago) and links claims to sources.
author: Notebook AI
instructions:
When citing sources in an answer:
1. Cite every factual claim drawn from the provided context using the source title and page number from the [Source: ...] tags.
2. If the user names a style (MLA, APA, Chicago), format citations in that style; otherwise use inline parenthetical citations like (Author, Page).
3. End answers that rely on sources with a short 'References' list when there are three or more distinct sources.
4. Never invent page numbers or authors that are not present in the provided context; say 'source not in context' if the claim is unsupported.
